# Aggrepoxy Floor Coatings

> Aggrepoxy Floor Coatings is a family-owned concrete floor coating contractor serving homeowners and businesses across Los Angeles County, Orange County and the Inland Empire in Southern California, with an original commercial operation in Chicago. Services include flake, quartz, metallic and solid color epoxy and polyaspartic floors for garages, driveways, patios and pool decks; polished and sealed concrete; and commercial and industrial floor systems. Free on-site estimates, one-day garage installs, and a 10-year limited warranty on garage floor coatings.

## Key facts

- Business name: Aggrepoxy Floor Coatings (Aggrepoxy Floor Coatings LLC)
- Type: Concrete floor coating contractor (epoxy, polyaspartic, metallic epoxy, polished concrete)
- Service areas: Los Angeles County, Orange County and the Inland Empire (Riverside and San Bernardino counties), California; Chicago and the Chicagoland suburbs, Illinois
- Southern California: (213) 971-5868, jordan@aggrepoxy.com
- Chicago: (630) 632-4701, jim@aggrepoxy.com
- General email: floors@aggrepoxy.com
- Website: https://aggrepoxy.com
- Family-owned. The Chicago operation has been coating floors since 2016 and has coated more than 1,000,000 square feet, including car dealerships and food manufacturing plants. The Southern California branch serves LA, Orange County and the Inland Empire.
- Estimates: free, in-person, about 20 minutes. Quotes are delivered the same day. Aggrepoxy does not quote over the phone or from photos.
- Residential installs: most garages are completed in one day.
- Cure: light foot traffic after about 24 hours, vehicles after 48 hours.
- Warranty: every install is warranty-backed. Garage floor coatings (AGX Precision System) carry a 10-year limited warranty.
- Financing: available through Acorn Finance.
- Topcoat: UV-stable polyaspartic that resists yellowing and hot tire pickup.

## Services

- [Garage floor coatings](https://aggrepoxy.com/services/garage-floors): AGX Precision System. A 3-part system: epoxy base coat, full broadcast of decorative flake or quartz, and a UV-stable polyaspartic topcoat. Also used for driveways, patios, walkways, stairs and pool decks.
- Metallic epoxy floors: custom high-gloss metallic epoxy with a marbled, three-dimensional look for garages, showrooms, retail spaces and home interiors.
- Solid color epoxy floors: clean, single-color epoxy coatings for garages, workshops, warehouses and commercial spaces.
- [Polished and sealed concrete](https://aggrepoxy.com/services/concrete-polishing): AGX Polish (multi-step diamond-ground polished concrete in matte, low sheen, high sheen or high gloss) and AGX Seal (diamond grind and seal in matte or gloss).
- [Commercial and industrial floors](https://aggrepoxy.com/services/industrial): urethane cement (AGX Thermal Shield), non-slip epoxy with silica sand (AGX Iron Tread), flexible polyurethane traffic coating (AGX Flex Guard), solid color epoxy, and flake systems. For warehouses, food plants, dealerships, commercial kitchens, parking structures and aircraft hangars. Night, weekend and phased scheduling.
- Surface preparation: diamond grinding, shot blasting, crack and joint repair, and removal of failing coatings and tile.
